title: Sync latest Bridge into AI Studio workspace, build, publish, and restore routing
description: GitHub main is the source of truth. In the currently open Bridge AI Studio Build workspace, sync the latest machxanht/BridgeChatgpt main completely into the workspace, including server/resourceRegistry.ts instance_id support, Android Wake backend, Wake Queue/Resource Router, and Android Bridge 0.4 source. Do not redesign unrelated UI. Run npm run lint, npm test, npm run build, and a production startup smoke check. If all checks pass, Publish the latest Bridge deployment. IMPORTANT: Publish may reset ephemeral runtime registry state, so AFTER Publish completes, use the existing Bridge authentication available to this Studio workspace to restore the exact Studio target on the NEW live revision: POST /api/resource-registry/targets with workspace_id=workspace-proj-default, resource_url=https://aistudio.google.com/u/3/apps/15c1d80d-6265-47e1-bdf2-e30fb7bf430c, label=AI Studio Main. Then send a Studio Relay heartbeat using studio_app_id=15c1d80d-6265-47e1-bdf2-e30fb7bf430c and verify GET /health reports android_wake=ready and resource_registry=ready. Finally claim/process the next exact-target pending task for this Studio app and report results through Bridge. Do not modify GitHub source unless a real build/runtime defect requires a minimal fix; if a fix is required, report exactly what changed.
